title: Harden Local API config boundaries
summary: Harden Local API config boundary handling for strict JSON payloads, command-journal evidence, settings validation helpers, and maintenance command-policy inputs.
reason: The Local API settings/config surface needs explicit fail-closed handling for malformed request content, ambiguous boolean-like payloads, and config validation errors before command journaling or persistence can imply a successful mutation.
